ok doc.insert()
ok frappe.has_permission("Quotation", "write", throw=True)
ok if frappe.session.user == "Administrator":
ok if frappe.session.user != doc.owner:
ok frappe.defaults.set_user_default("company", company)
ok permission_query_conditions = {"NC Time Entry": "nik_crafts.permissions.query"}
no-permission-bypass doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
no-permission-bypass doc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
no-permission-bypass frappe.flags.ignore_permissions = True
no-permission-bypass frappe.get_list("Quotation", ignore_permissions=True)
no-permission-bypass frappe.get_list("Quotation", ignore_user_permissions=True)
no-permission-bypass frappe.share.add_docshare(doctype, name, user, flags={"ignore_share_permission": True})
no-permission-bypass doc.flags.ignore_permlevel_for_fields = ["status"]
no-permission-bypass frappe.get_print(doctype, name, ignore_print_permissions=True)
no-permission-bypass link_options = search_widget(doctype, txt, ignore_select_perm=True)
no-permission-bypass frappe.set_user("Administrator")
no-permission-bypass frappe.local.login_manager.impersonate(user)
no-permission-bypass frappe.session.user = "Administrator"
no-permission-bypass frappe.local.session.user="Administrator"
